name: MortgageCalculator.me Widget
author: verifiednet

sections.description:
Give your visitors a mortgage calculator that shows the math. This plugin adds any of the 18 free calculators from MortgageCalculator.me to a post, page or sidebar. There’s no account, API key or setup.

Good for real estate agents, mortgage brokers, loan officers, credit unions, home builders and personal finance blogs.

Calculators

  • Mortgage payment (with taxes, insurance and PMI)
  • Mortgage refinance
  • Cash-out refinance
  • How much house can I afford
  • Amortization schedule
  • Additional (extra) payment
  • APR
  • Which loan is better
  • Mortgage points
  • Rent vs. buy
  • How much income do I need to qualify
  • Standard vs. bi-weekly payments
  • Interest only, and interest only with extra payments
  • Mortgage length
  • Mortgage principal
  • Mortgage tax benefits
  • Should I use a HELOC to pay off debt

Features

  • A “Mortgage Calculator” block with settings for the calculator, heading, theme and accent color
  • A [mortgage_calculator] shortcode for classic editors, widgets and page builders
  • Optional menu that lets visitors switch between all 18 calculators
  • Light, dark, or matches the visitor’s setting
  • Works on phones and fits any column width
  • Styles are isolated, so your theme and the calculator don’t clash

Shortcode examples

[mortgage_calculator]

[mortgage_calculator calculator="rent-vs-buy-calculator" theme="dark"]

[mortgage_calculator calculator="mortgage-refinance-calculator" picker="true" accent="#0f6b5c" width="640" title="Should you refinance?"]

Options:

  • calculator: which calculator. See the FAQ for the list. Default: mortgage-payment-calculator
  • picker: true shows a menu to switch calculators
  • title: heading text; none hides it. Default: the calculator’s name
  • theme: auto, light or dark
  • accent: button color as a hex value, such as #0f6b5c
  • width: maximum width in pixels. Default: fills the column

External services

This plugin is a front end for the MortgageCalculator.me calculator service, which does the calculations. It’s needed for the plugin to work.

On pages that show a calculator, the visitor’s browser loads the script https://mortgagecalculator.me/widget.js and sends the numbers the visitor enters to the MortgageCalculator.me API (https://mortgagecalculator.me/api/v1/) to get the results. Like any web request, this includes the visitor’s IP address and browser details. The service sets no cookies, does not track visitors, and does not save calculations. Its web server keeps standard request logs (IP address, browser, and the requested address, which includes the numbers entered) for about two weeks for security and troubleshooting. Nothing is sent from the WordPress admin, and nothing is sent on pages without a calculator.

The service is provided by MortgageCalculator.me (SiteTools, Inc.): Terms of Service, Privacy Policy.
sections.installation:
1. Install the plugin from Plugins > Add New, or upload the mortgagecalculator-me-widget folder to /wp-content/plugins/.
  2. Activate it.
  3. Edit a page, add the Mortgage Calculator block, and pick a calculator in the block settings. Or paste [mortgage_calculator] where you want it.
sections.faq:
Does it cost anything or need an API key?

No. The calculators are free and need no key or signup.

Which calculator names can I use in the shortcode?

mortgage-payment-calculator, mortgage-refinance-calculator, additional-payment-calculator, amortization-schedule-calculator, apr-calculator, which-loan-is-better-calculator, mortgage-points-calculator, rent-vs-buy-calculator, how-much-house-can-i-afford, how-much-income-do-i-need-to-qualify, standard-vs-biweekly-calculator, interest-only-calculator, interest-only-with-additional-payment-calculator, mortgage-length-calculator, mortgage-principal-calculator, tax-benefits-calculator, cash-out-refinance-calculator, should-i-use-heloc.

Why does the editor show a card instead of the calculator?

The calculator runs on the published page. Use Preview to try it.

Can I use it in a sidebar?

Yes. Add the block in Appearance > Widgets, or put the shortcode in a Shortcode or Text widget.

Is there an API?

Yes, a free JSON API with the same calculators: mortgagecalculator.me/developers.
